method: Leave-one-participant-out. Features from observed preceding calendar dates only; no current/future outcomes, imputed rows, inferred phases or LLM labels. Dates were changed by the source authors.
limitations: Not a confirmed-endometriosis cohort; no wearable measurements are included.
Only 304 of 2160 released rows are directly observed; imputed rows are excluded entirely.

Checklists are available on a selected subset of observed days. Unanswered checklists are unknown; unselected entries within an answered checklist are coded not selected, not clinically confirmed absent.
The intervention trial and selective reporting limit applicability to natural symptom forecasting.
Only five severe-pain targets in paired observations; severe-flare performance cannot be established.
Participant-held-out evaluation is not prospective clinical validation. Source date shifting and unknown arrival times limit real-time interpretation.
Hyperparameters fixed for an exploratory run; there are no confidence intervals or independent replication.
